items.title: expo/exact
items.summary: Expo Exact is a cross-platform framework designed to build native applications for web, macOS, iOS, and Linux using a unified codebase. It specifically optimizes for AI agents, allowing them to build, execute, visually inspect, and test the application across all supported platforms.
items.why_it_matters: It bridges the gap between cross-platform development and autonomous coding agents by providing a consistent environment for AI to interact with native UI. This could significantly accelerate the development cycle for multi-platform apps through automated agentic workflows.
